name: ltads-state
question: What is the LTADS state of this project: permanent/temporary/legacy/none, the arc record's validity and topmost arc, FRESH/CONTINUATION mode, session id, and status?
cost_provenance: re-measured 2026-07-22 (v1.1.0 arc-state validation legs: ~800ms with arc-state.json present, ~400ms without) under Git Bash (win32; slowest supported environment) -- pessimistic-honest per ORACLE-COST-01; under-declaration causes timeout kills

schema.state: one of: none, permanent, temporary, legacy, incomplete_temp, broken
schema.cleanup_candidate: boolean (LTADS-GC-01: true when state=temporary and spec-progress True Progress is exhausted, or state=incomplete_temp orphan; offer ~/.claude/segments/-ltads/_temp-ltads-cleanup.md)
schema.session_id: string|null (topmost arc id when arc-state.json is valid; legacy prose **ID** otherwise)
schema.session_status: string|null (topmost arc status when arc-state.json is valid; legacy prose Status otherwise)
schema.arc_state: one of: valid, invalid, legacy, absent, unvalidated (ARC-01 schema-validation verdict; legacy = prose-only current-session.md, the ARC-11 migration surfacing trigger; unvalidated = lib/jq unavailable, NO-DATA never false-green)
schema.arc_mode: FRESH|CONTINUATION|null (ARC-06 two-fact rule: absent file or topmost CONCLUDED => FRESH, topmost ACTIVE/PAUSED => CONTINUATION; null when the verdict forbids deriving a mode)
schema.topmost_arc: object|null ({id, status, boundConsentExpired} of arcs[0] when arc_state=valid)
schema.size_warning: boolean (ARC-01 cap-approach WARN: arc-state.json > 80% of the ~4KB cap; breach handling is lib rotation, never truncation)

fallback: Check if ltads/ exists; read ltads/config.json for temporary flag; read ltads/arc-state.json topmost arc via the arc-state lib getters (fall back to ltads/sessions/current-session.md Status on prose-only projects); run git ls-files ltads/ for tracking status.

provenance.note: Formalized from the state detection logic originally embedded in session-start.ps1/sh (the inline 'first oracle' of ULDF).
